title: FAQs - Request for New PAN - Protean Pan & Tan Services

service.name: Request for New PAN Card or/and Changes or Correction in PAN data
alternate_names: नये पैन कार्ड या / और पैन डेटा में परिवर्तन या संशोधन के लिए अनुरोध

eligibility.value: Persons who already have PAN but want a new PAN card, or want to make changes/corrections in existing PAN details.
eligibility.quote: You can submit the application in the form "Request for New PAN Card or/and Changes or Correction in PAN data" in the following cases: 1. When you already have PAN but want a new PAN card, 2. When you want to make some changes or corrections in your existing PAN details.

fact.quote: Proof of PAN (the one currently in use - mentioned at the top of the application) if available;
Proof of Date of Birth (for Individual and Karta of HUF)

documents.name: Proof in support of changes sought

fact.value: Proof in support of changes sought
fact.quote: Proof in support of changes sought*, if any;
Proof of PAN(s) surrendered, if any;

fees.value: Fee for physical PAN card dispatch in India is Rs 107 (inclusive of taxes) at TIN-FCs/Physical mode, or Rs 101 via paperless mode. Dispatch outside India is Rs 1,017 or Rs 1,011 respectively. Without physical PAN card (e-PAN only) fee is Rs 72 or Rs 66.
fees.quote: Dispatch of physical PAN Card in India (Communication address is Indian address) | 91 | 107

issuing_authority.quote: This facility is only available for those PAN holders whose latest PAN application was processed through Protean e-Gov and / or e-Filing portal of Income Tax Department.

steps.value: Fill all the columns of the form and tick the box(es) on the left margin of the appropriate item where change/correction is to be done.
steps.quote: The applicant is required to fill all the columns of the form and tick the box(es) on the left margin of the appropriate item where change/correction is to be done.
